gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-martel-sans: Martel Sans keeps its curves generously open and its mean line high, so every word looks plainly spoken. Martel Sans against Woodgod's vintage, commanding heading gives the pair its real strength: a loud voice and a clear one.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-matangi: Vintage muscle meets twine-thin lines. Woodgod hammers out the heading with wide channels into every bowl, and Matangi follows in rounded, hefty lowercase that looks pressed flat like wire.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-maven-pro: Loud old-school swagger over a quiet, even-handed text face, with Woodgod's tall lowercase nearly touching its capitals. Woodgod is built to command; Maven Pro is built to welcome.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-michroma: Woodgod's tall lowercase nearly reaches its capitals, which gives the heading a vintage, commanding stance. And Michroma sets each letter apart with a wide berth, so the plain sans body reads as modern and spaced out.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-miriam-libre: Cast-iron stature, drawn in wire. Woodgod's heading carries the vintage weight, and Miriam Libre's sans-serif body keeps its strokes uniform and its s generously open for a friendly read.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One has an oversized lowercase eye and letters sketched with a pencil that never presses harder. Mochiy Pop One lets Woodgod's commanding, vintage heading do the shouting while it speaks in a flat, uniform line.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Woodgod leads with a wide channel into every bowl and tall lowercase that nearly meets its capitals. And it earns its keep when set big and brief, above Mochiy Pop P One's single-width sans-serif lines.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-montserrat-underli: Montserrat Underline reads with oversized lowercase and flat, single-weight bowls that never swell or taper anywhere in a line. Across a long stretch it stays smooth, steady and quietly unfussy.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline brings big-bodied lowercase letters and a splayed c terminal to the plain sans body, which feels approachable and current. Woodgod's vintage command is what sets it apart.
gen-dafont-woodgod-gf-mozilla-text: Woodgod opens the pair with a commanding, vintage voice, its tall lowercase nearly reaching the capitals. But Mozilla Text, a plain sans with flared terminals and tall bodies, keeps a longer read looking bold yet composed.
